purpose: Coverage-repair successor to Q077 after the original fixed source-order pool left fewer than eight unused symbols. This successor changes only the ex-ante candidate source pool; performance and holdout information are never consulted.
selection_rule: Exclude symbols already claimed by currently registered research universes, frozen preregistrations and prior research evidence as implemented by fixed_window_candidate_discovery._prior_research_symbols; from the remaining frozen source-order pool, evaluate only the fixed 2011-01-01 through 2025-09-24 coverage contract and retain the first symbols yielding at least 3500 common sessions.
predecessor_finding: Q077 fixed pool produced only four coverage-valid symbols after research-universe exclusions, causing a fail-closed no-batch result.
